meta.data_quality: Strikes flagged 'stale_iv': true had stale implied_volatility (>200%) replaced with null; the original quote is preserved in 'raw_implied_volatility' for provenance. Their OI and GEX fields are retained-with-flag — IV-derived gamma for these strikes is suspect and consumers may exclude them. Exported open_interest / call_oi / put_oi may conflate true-zero OI with missing data — the source emits NaN openInterest on dead strikes and aggregation collapses it to 0; rows with missing (nonfinite) OI are excluded from max-pain payout sums. 'gamma_flip' is null when no material sign crossing exists for that expiry. Expiries flagged 'metrics_unavailable': true had insufficient usable data for the payout metrics: 'data_quality' on the expiry is 'no_finite_oi' (every openInterest value missing) or 'insufficient_data' (the usable chain is degenerate — fewer than 2 distinct strikes carrying finite open interest, or zero total finite OI — so the payout argmin would be mathematically valid but economically meaningless). All of their max_pain* and band-flag fields are explicit nulls — never artifact values. 'gamma_flip' is computed from the gex profile independently of OI eligibility, so it may still carry a real crossing on a flagged expiry. Whole-book metrics are unaffected.

metric_definitions.gamma_flip: Strike-profile proxy at the current spot: the material negative->positive net-gex sign crossing nearest spot under a modeled call-long/put-short dealer convention. It is NOT a repriced-chain zero-gamma flip.
metric_definitions.materiality_floor: A strike's gex is material iff |gex| >= max(1% of the slice's max |gex|, 1e-3 $M-per-1% ~= $1k notional gamma). Sub-floor slices return gamma_flip = null.
metric_definitions.max_pain: Canonical UNCONSTRAINED max pain: the strike minimizing total option payout across all strikes in the chain.
metric_definitions.max_pain_constrained: Constrained payout minimum: the payout argmin restricted to 'max_pain_candidate_band' ([0.7*spot, 1.3*spot]) — NOT a 'nearest-to-spot' metric. 'max_pain_band_fell_back' marks the empty-band fallback to all strikes; 'max_pain_band_boundary_hit' marks a minimum landing exactly on a band edge; 'max_pain_selected_lowest_candidate' / 'max_pain_selected_highest_candidate' mark selection of the lowest / highest ELIGIBLE candidate when no listed strike equals a band edge. Rows with missing (nonfinite) openInterest are excluded from all payout sums.
metric_definitions.metrics_unavailable: True when an expiry's rows could not support the payout metrics; 'data_quality' on the expiry is 'no_finite_oi' (every openInterest value missing) or 'insufficient_data' (degenerate chain: fewer than 2 distinct finite-OI strikes, or zero total finite OI — see 'payout_eligibility'). All max_pain*/band-flag fields for that expiry are explicit nulls rather than artifact values. gamma_flip is an independent metric and may still be non-null.
metric_definitions.payout_eligibility: max_pain / max_pain_constrained are only emitted when the expiry has at least 2 DISTINCT strikes carrying finite openInterest AND positive total finite OI. A single-strike chain has a vacuous argmin (one candidate, payout 0 at it) and a zero-OI chain makes every candidate an argmin — both are flagged 'insufficient_data' instead of reporting a meaningless strike.

system_prompt: You are an institutional options market strategist specializing in dealer positioning, gamma exposure, volatility regime analysis, and market microstructure.
analysis_query: Analyze the gamma exposure, opened interest data to predict market maker plan to their interest, show gamma flip strikes, call/put wall with OI, stock, TSM

interpretation_rules.positive_gamma: Expect lower volatility and mean reversion
interpretation_rules.negative_gamma: Expect higher volatility and trend acceleration
